name: workshop_preparation_24_turns
description: One continuous, realistic user journey. Every turn contains one spoken user request and one camera image.

turns.prompt: Hi Soo, I'm Nora. I'm preparing an AI literacy workshop for teachers tomorrow. Please stay with me while I get ready.
Look at my desk. What three main objects can you see?
Which item is immediately to the left of the laptop?
Read the workshop time and room from this schedule.
Remember that plan. The event starts at two thirty in Room A.
Which sticky note is marked high priority?
I finished printing the badges. Which unfinished task should I do next?
How many supply boxes are on the table?
I removed one box. Compared with the previous view, how many are left?
Which budget item costs the most, and how much is it?
What is the combined cost of the cables and badges?
The venue has changed. Read the updated room and keep the same time.
The schedule is no longer in view. Remind me of the current room and time.
This slide says AI saves fifty percent of teachers' time. What evidence limitation is visible?
Give me one cautious sentence I can say on stage about that claim.
I'm getting nervous. Give me one short encouraging sentence and smile.
Wave once and say exactly: Welcome, everyone.
Keep a serious expression and tell me one reason not to overstate this pilot.
I changed my badge. From now on, call me Maya, not Nora.
What should you call me now, and what kind of event am I preparing?
I just spilled water beside the power strip. What should I do first?
I've unplugged it and dried the area. Does the picture still show a visible puddle?
Review this final checklist and tell me the only unchecked item.
Before I go, recap my current name, room, time, and remaining task, then wave goodbye.
